final_answer:
Three of the 26 high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. I counted a URS as high-risk when an FRA row rates it HIGH through an ASSESSES link. The other 23 each have a SCRIPTED verifying test case whose latest execution is PASS on every applicable unit. None of those passes predates a relevant change control.

| Requirement | Reason |
|---|---|
| **URS-EBR-009** | No test case verifies it. CS-EBR-03 satisfies it, but no test case is linked to CS-EBR-03 or to the URS itself. The other EBR requirements each have a test case. |
| **URS-INC-004** | The only verifying test case, TC-OQ-INC-04 (door-open alarm), FAILED on INC-03 (TX-0023, 2026-02-10, "Alarm activated at 142 s"). It passed on INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04. CC-26-019 (INC-03 door switch replacement, with re-execution of TC-OQ-INC-04) is approved but not implemented, so there is no later passing run. The OQ report was approved with an exception (DEV-26-011). INC-03 is therefore unverified. |
| **URS-EMS-014** | The verification is stale. It is verified through CS-EMS-03 by TC-OQ-EMS-04, last passed on 2026-01-20 (TX-0070). CC-26-011 modified CS-EMS-03 (EMS notification group restructure) and was implemented on 2026-03-16, after that pass. The change control says no re-testing is required, but under the stale-verification rule the pass predates the change. |

- **URS-CRF-001 (not counted):** It is a PERFORMANCE requirement on equipment and has only an OQ test, with no PQ evidence. Under the currently-verified rule this is not a failure, because that rule doesn't require PQ. I left it out of the three above.
- **FRZ-80-02 (not counted):** CC-26-014 (compressor replacement) affects it. The OQ tests were re-executed and passed on 2026-04-24, after the 2026-04-23 implementation. URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002 are therefore still verified.

input.query:
with recursive hr as (
 select s.item_id urs from pd.trace_link l join pd.val_risk_item r on r.ri_id=l.src_id join pd.val_spec_item s on s.item_id=l.tgt_id
 where l.link_type='ASSESSES' and r.risk_class='HIGH' and s.spec_level='URS'),
chain as (
 select urs, urs as spec from hr
 union
 select c.urs, l.src_id from chain c join pd.trace_link l on l.link_type='TRACE' and l.tgt_id=c.spec),
tcs as (
 select distinct c.urs, c.spec, l.src_id tc from chain c join pd.trace_link l on l.link_type='VERIFIES' and l.tgt_id=c.spec)
select hr.urs, string_agg(distinct t.spec||'<-'||t.tc||':'||tc.method, ', ') from hr left join tcs t on t.urs=hr.urs left join pd.val_test_case tc on tc.tc_id=t.tc group by hr.urs order by 1
select tc_id, target_id, exec_id, exec_dt, result, actual_result from pd.val_test_exec order by tc_id, target_id, exec_dt

content.text:
Three of the 26 high-risk user requirements are not currently verified. I counted a URS as high-risk when an FRA row rates it HIGH through an ASSESSES link. The other 23 each have a SCRIPTED verifying test case whose latest execution is PASS on every applicable unit. None of those passes predates a relevant change control.

| Requirement | Reason |
|---|---|
| **URS-EBR-009** | No test case verifies it. CS-EBR-03 satisfies it, but no test case is linked to CS-EBR-03 or to the URS itself. The other EBR requirements each have a test case. |
| **URS-INC-004** | The only verifying test case, TC-OQ-INC-04 (door-open alarm), FAILED on INC-03 (TX-0023, 2026-02-10, "Alarm activated at 142 s"). It passed on INC-01, INC-02 and INC-04. CC-26-019 (INC-03 door switch replacement, with re-execution of TC-OQ-INC-04) is approved but not implemented, so there is no later passing run. The OQ report was approved with an exception (DEV-26-011). INC-03 is therefore unverified. |
| **URS-EMS-014** | The verification is stale. It is verified through CS-EMS-03 by TC-OQ-EMS-04, last passed on 2026-01-20 (TX-0070). CC-26-011 modified CS-EMS-03 (EMS notification group restructure) and was implemented on 2026-03-16, after that pass. The change control says no re-testing is required, but under the stale-verification rule the pass predates the change. |

- **URS-CRF-001 (not counted):** It is a PERFORMANCE requirement on equipment and has only an OQ test, with no PQ evidence. Under the currently-verified rule this is not a failure, because that rule doesn't require PQ. I left it out of the three above.
- **FRZ-80-02 (not counted):** CC-26-014 (compressor replacement) affects it. The OQ tests were re-executed and passed on 2026-04-24, after the 2026-04-23 implementation. URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002 are therefore still verified.
